title: 麻将胡了 2 金龙四肢动作候选（Kling）
prompt: Create a seamless 5-second portrait loop from this exact image. Keep the camera fixed. Preserve the dragon's exact anatomy and keep all four legs visible for the entire clip: two forelegs and two hind legs, all attached naturally to the same continuous torso. Give the dragon clear body motion rather than camera motion: the head lifts and turns slightly, the torso rises and settles, the tail sweeps in a broad smooth arc, and all four legs make a small alternating swimming/flying stroke so each of the four paws visibly changes position. Keep the four paws separated and countable; do not let a leg disappear behind the torso, tail, or tiles. Preserve the dragon's face, scales, gold/jade colors, body continuity, and all four face-up mahjong tiles with unchanged symbols. Make the action visibly readable at phone-card size, with no abrupt deformation. Return to the starting composition at the end for a smooth loop.
